overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve all but one set of meeting minutes, rejected its argument that the complaint was untimely, and ordered future compliance with no further remedy since the minutes were since approved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to timely approve several sets of its meeting minutes; the Committee argued the complaint itself was untimely filed.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve all but one set of meeting minutes at issue in the complaint

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
